title: Crestline Fleet Account Invoiced Volume Adjustment to the Late-Charge Rate
content:
A Crestline Fleet Account that carries a large volume of invoiced work has its late-charge rate lowered.

| Invoices posted less than twelve whole months before the day the charge is assessed, in total (USD) | Invoiced volume adjustment |
|---|---|
| 50000.00 or more | minus 0.20 |
| 25000.00 to 49999.99 | minus 0.10 |
| less than 25000.00 | nothing |

The total is the sum of the invoice amounts of every fleet invoice posted to the account with an invoice date less than twelve whole months before the day the charge is assessed.

## Boundaries

- 24999.99: nothing; 25000.00: minus 0.10.
- 49999.99: minus 0.10; 50000.00: minus 0.20.

The adjustment is in percentage points and is added to the late-charge rate, the percent charged on the day the charge is assessed; a program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0 charges nothing, whatever is added to the late-charge rate.
